story.title: 'Doctor Who' actor Noel Clarke pleads 'not guilty' to sexual offence charges
story.summary: British actor and filmmaker Noel Clarke appeared in a London court on Wednesday and pleaded not guilty to six charges, including two counts of sexual assault.

story.title: ‘Mookuthi Amman 2’ trailer: Nayanthara plays a cop and a goddess
story.summary: Nayanthara returns as the divine Mookuthi Amman in the sequel set to release on November 6. The film introduces a new conflict involving supernatural antagonists that threaten humanity. Directors Sundar C and RJ Balaji bring their creative visions to this expanded cinematic adventure. The trailer presents Nayanthara's contrasting characters, blending action and humor within a mythical framework.

story.title: 'Ranabaali' BO day 6: Vijay Deverakonda film earns Rs 59.65 cr
story.summary: The film Ranabaali, with stars Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna, achieved a remarkable Rs 59.65 crore in total earnings worldwide. On its sixth day, it garnered Rs 5.50 crore, reflecting a decline from Rs 7.10 crore previously. Released on October 16, the film recorded 453,848 total footfalls, maintaining an average occupancy of 40.44% for the Telugu version.
